statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2026-0441 is an informational notice that the pin-utils crate is unmaintained and identifies no patched release. Milvus includes pin-utils 0.1.0 transitively through futures-util and hyper (and, in Milvus 3.0, the AWS Smithy runtime crates in the milvus-storage bridge); removing it requires those upstream crates to drop the dependency and remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0441.html
